name: Soushitsu
source:
Saito, a detective with the Prefectural Police Headquarters, was placed on administrative leave after his reckless actions, driven by a sense of justice, backfired. During his leave, a series of kidnappings began to occur. Saito decided to conduct his own investigation, but this was merely the prelude to the tragedy that would engulf him.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4710720/]Steam[/url]]
